body.name: Pref
body.def: When \(p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,C,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)>0\), first restrict and normalize \(\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,\mathrm{base}}\) on \(C'_n(\rho)=C_n(\rho)=C\), then independently draw each quota-respecting \(z'_{n2s}\) only for \(C_s=1\). The resulting \(\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,C}\) has support exactly \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\); each supported history has mass \(p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,C,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)^{-1}\prod_{s\in S}\{\binom{N_{n1s}}{\lfloor\rho N_{n1s}\rfloor}\binom{N_{n1s}}{m_{n1s}}\}^{-1}\prod_{s:C_s=1}\binom{N_{n2s}}{m_{n2s}}^{-1}\), and its statistic is \(T'_j(\theta_j)\).
